title: Conkers String Smash
tagline: Swing your conker and smash theirs to bits.
description: England's autumn playground game with real pendulum physics. Pull the conker back, time the release against the other hand's sway, and hit the pale soft spot: every touch cracks both conkers until one shatters. Tin of three conkers, a four-rival Conker Cup, Two Players, Think and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Press on the scene, drag back and let go to swing your conker.
Raise or lower your hand to hit their pale patch: the soft spot.
Watch the guide and the timing strip, then release at a good moment.
Three goes a turn; every touch cracks both conkers until one shatters.
The winner's conker carries the loser's wins: oner, twoer, fifer, sixer.
